headlines.title: Smithsonian Secretary Lonnie Bunch is leaving amid tensions with Trump
headlines.description: Lonnie G. Bunch III will step down from his position as head of the sprawling Smithsonian Institution by the end of the year, he said Tuesday.

headlines.title: New Hampshire primaries test Trump and the left
headlines.description: President Donald Trump’s endorsement will be put to the test once again Tuesday in New Hampshire’s primaries, where liberal Democrats are also looking to cap an ascendant primary season with additional victories.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy's defense attorney requests Trump pardon: Is it legally possible?
headlines.description: Kevin Reddington, Lindsay Clancy’s defense attorney, spoke out for the first time since her state murder trial ended in a mistrial, calling on President Trump to pardon his client. NBC News' Danny Cevallos explains the legal limits of the request.

headlines.title: Inside Secret Screening of Nathan Fielder’s Elizabeth Holmes Doc
headlines.description: Cult-comedian Nathan Fielder’s new documentary “You Can See Everything” that features unprecedented access to the life of tech founder-turned-convict Elizabeth Holmes had a surprise screening at the Telluride Film Festival. The nearly three-hour film left the audience both unsettled and wanting more. NBC’s Erin McLaughlin reports for TODAY and speaks to NBC News Digital reporter Rebecca Keegan who attended the top-secret screening.

headlines.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs on the U.S. go into effect
headlines.description: Canada's dollar-for-dollar retaliatory tariffs on the United States have gone into effect and cover $20 billion of American goods. NBC News' Monica Alba and Allie Canal report on the new counter-tariffs and the impact it could have on everyday product.

headlines.title: Kornacki Cam: Watch Steve analyze New Hampshire primary election results
headlines.description: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki breaks down real-time vote tallies from primary elections in New Hampshire, while giving viewers a behind-the-scenes look at election night coverage.

headlines.title: 4 family members confirmed dead in Bahamas plane crash, relatives say
headlines.description: The bodies of four family members were recovered during a desperate search after a small private aircraft crashed about 15 miles off the coast of the largest Bahamian island Monday, according to relatives.

headlines.title: Smithsonian Secretary Lonnie Bunch is leaving amid tensions with Trump
headlines.description: Lonnie G. Bunch III will step down from his position as head of the sprawling Smithsonian Institution by the end of the year, he said Tuesday.

headlines.title: Authorities identify 5 victims killed when Amazon-branded cargo plane overran runway in Miami
headlines.description: An airline cleaning company was mourning the loss of five employees who were identified as those killed Sunday when an Amazon-branded cargo plane overran the runway at Miami International Airport, striking the company’s van and a passenger SUV.

headlines.title: Widespread flight delays hit major British airports
headlines.description: Flights departing from two of London’s Heathrow Airport have been grounded following a “technical issue.”

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy’s attorney asks for Trump pardon in first interview since state mistrial
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy’s attorney spoke out for the first time Tuesday since her state murder trial ended in a mistrial, including calling on President Donald Trump to pardon his client.

headlines.title: Oil nears $100 after Saudi Arabia says energy infrastructure was attacked
headlines.description: Brent, the international oil benchmark, touched $99 a barrel after Saudi Arabia reported an attack on energy assets that caused temporary pauses in operations.
